description: This file sets up custom fields, reports, and permissions for the Italian regional module in ERPNext, including configuration for invoices, customer data, and permissions related to Italian fiscal regulations.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup function that creates custom fields, sets up the report, and adds permissions.

methods.name: make_custom_fields
methods.description: Defines and creates custom fields for various doctype in the Italian regional module, including invoice and customer data.

methods.name: setup_report
methods.description: Enables the 'Electronic Invoice Register' report and assigns roles to it.

methods.name: add_permissions
methods.description: Sets permissions for the 'Import Supplier Invoice' doctype, including roles and access rights.
